_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Riolo nuwiwi {player_id} ri Three-Player Tic Tac Toe.
Simbolu nuwiwi ri '{symbol}'.
Riolo nuwiwi mappasili simbolu nuwiwi ri papan 5x5 makkala liné empa.
Liné éréngé horizontal, vertical, atawa diagonal.
Sérékka gau nuwiwi ri format '[4]' makkala cell 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Format appelleengeng de'na valid. Pakkegunai "[cell]" ri onrong sel e iyanaritu 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Cell nuwiwi salah: {cell}. Makkala riolo antara 0 sié {max_cell}.

game_action.placed: Riolo {player_id} mappasili simbolu nuwiwi ({symbol}) ri tanété ({row}, {col}).
